The error occurred in the release build because R8 code shrinking stripped generic type signatures (`Signature` attribute) and optimized away anonymous `TypeToken` subclasses, preventing Gson from resolving the generic type argument `List<Book>` at runtime. Additionally, R8 would obfuscate model field names needed for Gson's reflection-based deserialization.

The fix has been applied directly to [proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-B-r2/work/app/proguard-rules.pro#L1-L15):

- Kept generic `Signature` and `*Annotation*` attributes so generic signatures are preserved for reflection.
- Kept `com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken` and classes extending it.
- Kept model classes in `vn.shelftap.lab.model.**` and annotated serialized fields so reflection mappings remain intact after minification.
